digest.title: Class Is in Session: GeForce NOW Levels Up Linux, Chromebooks and More
digest.tldr: GeForce NOW is giving cloud gaming an extra-credit upgrade just in time for back-to-school season.  The native Linux app for GeForce NOW is officially out of beta.

digest.title: OpenAI appoints Dali Rajic as Chief Revenue Officer
digest.tldr: OpenAI appoints Dali Rajic as Chief Revenue Officer to lead its global revenue organization and help businesses realize the full value of AI.
